text:
maria: Hey team — PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/842. It's a profile bump for centaur-7b: tokenizer tweak + dynamic_kvprofile. Need quick eyes for compat and perf. CI passing locally but flaky on windows runners. Can someone take a look? aiming to merge Thu EOD if no blockers.

josh: taking a look now. is this changing vocab.json?

maria: small token normalization tweak, + updated quant profile. vocab unchanged.

eng-bot: CI started · 5 jobs running · e2e/serving pending

kai: saw the diff — dynamic KV cache flag looks fine. can you add a brief note in the profile about expected tokenization diff? helps future rollbacks.

maria: good call. added a note in the PR description. also added a smoke test snippet: ```python
resp = client.generate(...)
assert 'Hello' in resp.text
```

li: I'll do a quick compatibility run on the staging pool in ~1h. if all good, can approve.

oliver: quick nit — in quant profile, change 'prefetch' -> 'batch_prefetch' for clarity. otherwise LGTM

maria: updated name, thanks @oliver. @li ping me if you see perf regressions.

eng-bot: CI ✅ (4/5) flaky e2e infra failing — rerun queued

josh: left two tiny comments inline. nothing blocking.

li: staging run passed perf thresholds. small 1.2% latency increase p95 but within SLO. approving shortly.

oliver: approving. :+1:

maria: thanks all — will merge Thu 18:00 UTC if no other blockers. :rocket:
